evidence: A relation-aware RGCN that keeps associated_with, ligand-target, PPI and GO edge types reaches macro AUPRC 0.976050 and micro 0.964371
observation: An R-GCN that keeps associated_with, ligand-target, PPI and GO edge types reached macro AUPRC 0.976050 and micro 0.964371 as a ten-seed rank ensemble, with 95% macro interval [0.971643, 0.98]; the mean of its seeds was 0.95065/0.937113. Mixing it 40/60 with GATv2+GraphSAGE gave 0.974460/0.966500, and F-0023 first named it the primary macro-AUPRC model.
subject: F-30
title: Relation-aware RGCN is the strongest committed-protocol model
